questions.question: What will be the current passing through the ring shaped air cored coil number of turns is 800 and ampere turns are 3200?
questions.explanation: Ampere-turns means number of turns multiplied by current. So current = 3200 / 800 = 4.0 A.
explanationLines: Ampere-turns means number of turns multiplied by current.
So current = 3200 / 800 = 4.0 A.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Force between two conductors is attractive when...........
questions.explanation: The source says same-direction currents reinforce each other. This produces attractive force between the conductors.
explanationLines: The source says same-direction currents reinforce each other.
This produces attractive force between the conductors.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Mmf is analogous to........
questions.explanation: Mmf drives flux in a magnetic circuit. It is compared with emf in an electric circuit.
explanationLines: Mmf drives flux in a magnetic circuit.
It is compared with emf in an electric circuit.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Dot notation indicates...........
questions.explanation: Dot notation is used to show current direction. In the source exercise, dot means current flows out.
explanationLines: Dot notation is used to show current direction.
In the source exercise, dot means current flows out.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Magnetic field around a straight current carrying conductor is given by........
options: B = mu0 n I / 2 pi r
questions.explanation: A straight current-carrying conductor has circular magnetic field lines. The field depends on current and distance from the conductor.
explanationLines: A straight current-carrying conductor has circular magnetic field lines.
The field depends on current and distance from the conductor.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Cross notation indicates........
questions.explanation: Cross notation is used to show current direction. In the source exercise, cross means current flows in.
explanationLines: Cross notation is used to show current direction.
In the source exercise, cross means current flows in.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Magnetic field in a solenoid is given by............
options: B = mu0 n I / 2 pi r
questions.explanation: The source gives solenoid field as proportional to turns per unit length. It is also proportional to the current through the solenoid.
explanationLines: The source gives solenoid field as proportional to turns per unit length.
It is also proportional to the current through the solenoid.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Force between two conductors is repulsive when............
questions.explanation: Opposite-direction currents make fields cancel each other. The source says this gives repulsive force between conductors.
explanationLines: Opposite-direction currents make fields cancel each other.
The source says this gives repulsive force between conductors.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Hysteresis loop provides............
questions.explanation: The source says the B-H loop area represents hysteresis loss. This loss appears as heat during magnetization cycles.
explanationLines: The source says the B-H loop area represents hysteresis loss.
This loss appears as heat during magnetization cycles.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Energy stored in magnetic field is given by..........
questions.explanation: Energy stored in an inductor depends on L and I squared. So the correct expression is 1/2 L I^2.
explanationLines: Energy stored in an inductor depends on L and I squared.
So the correct expression is 1/2 L I^2.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In hysteresis curve the value of hysteresis loss is given by ............
questions.explanation: The source says the area enclosed by the B-H curve is hysteresis loss. A smaller loop area gives smaller hysteresis loss.
explanationLines: The source says the area enclosed by the B-H curve is hysteresis loss.
A smaller loop area gives smaller hysteresis loss.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is electromagnetism mainly about?
options: Relation between electric current and magnetic field
questions.correctOption: Relation between electric current and magnetic field
questions.explanation: The source defines electromagnetism as current and magnetic field interaction. It also includes magnetic field production by electric current.
explanationLines: The source defines electromagnetism as current and magnetic field interaction.
It also includes magnetic field production by electric current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is the magnetic field developed around a current carrying conductor called?
questions.explanation: A current carrying conductor develops a magnetic field around it. The source calls this field an electromagnetic field.
explanationLines: A current carrying conductor develops a magnetic field around it.
The source calls this field an electromagnetic field.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which devices are directly linked with magnetic effect of current in the source?
questions.explanation: The source lists motors, generators and transformers as applications. They use the magnetic effect of electric current.
explanationLines: The source lists motors, generators and transformers as applications.
They use the magnetic effect of electric current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is the shape of magnetic field lines around a straight current carrying conductor?
questions.explanation: The source says the field has cylindrical symmetry. Its field lines form concentric circles around the conductor.
explanationLines: The source says the field has cylindrical symmetry.
Its field lines form concentric circles around the conductor.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: If distance from a straight current carrying conductor increases, what happens to magnetic field B?
questions.explanation: The source states that B decreases as distance increases. So farther points have weaker magnetic field.
explanationLines: The source states that B decreases as distance increases.
So farther points have weaker magnetic field.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rule determines direction of magnetic field around a straight conductor?
questions.explanation: The source says the direction is found by right hand thumb rule. This rule links current direction with field direction.
explanationLines: The source says the direction is found by right hand thumb rule.
This rule links current direction with field direction.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is a solenoid?
questions.explanation: The source defines solenoid as a coil wound in cylindrical shape. Current through it produces a magnetic field.
explanationLines: The source defines solenoid as a coil wound in cylindrical shape.
Current through it produces a magnetic field.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The magnetic field of a solenoid is similar to which object?
questions.explanation: The source says a solenoid has north and south poles at its ends. That makes its field similar to a bar magnet.
explanationLines: The source says a solenoid has north and south poles at its ends.
That makes its field similar to a bar magnet.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Inside a solenoid, the magnetic field is nearly ............
questions.explanation: The source states that field inside the solenoid is nearly uniform. Outside the coil it is negligible except at the ends.
explanationLines: The source states that field inside the solenoid is nearly uniform.
Outside the coil it is negligible except at the ends.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Magnetic field inside a solenoid is proportional to ............
questions.explanation: The source says the field depends on turns per unit length and current. More turns or more current gives stronger field.
explanationLines: The source says the field depends on turns per unit length and current.
More turns or more current gives stronger field.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rule is used to find poles of a solenoid?
questions.explanation: The source uses right hand grip rule for solenoid poles. Curled fingers show current and thumb points to north pole.
explanationLines: The source uses right hand grip rule for solenoid poles.
Curled fingers show current and thumb points to north pole.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What happens when a current carrying conductor is placed in a magnetic field?
questions.explanation: The source says interaction of current and field produces force. This force is used in electric motors.
explanationLines: The source says interaction of current and field produces force.
This force is used in electric motors.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Force on a current carrying conductor depends on which group?
questions.explanation: The source lists magnetic flux density, current and length. These factors decide the force on the conductor.
explanationLines: The source lists magnetic flux density, current and length.
These factors decide the force on the conductor.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The force on a conductor is maximum when the conductor is ............ to magnetic field.
questions.explanation: The source says the force is maximum at perpendicular position. This gives strongest interaction between current and magnetic field.
explanationLines: The source says the force is maximum at perpendicular position.
This gives strongest interaction between current and magnetic field.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rule gives the direction of force on a current carrying conductor?
questions.explanation: The source says Fleming's left hand rule gives force direction. It is applicable for motors.
explanationLines: The source says Fleming's left hand rule gives force direction.
It is applicable for motors.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In Fleming's left hand rule, the thumb indicates ............
questions.explanation: The source explains thumb as motion or induced force. The fore finger and middle finger show field and current.
explanationLines: The source explains thumb as motion or induced force.
The fore finger and middle finger show field and current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: When two parallel conductors carry current in the same direction, their fields ............
questions.explanation: The source says same-direction currents reinforce magnetic fields. This causes attraction between the conductors.
explanationLines: The source says same-direction currents reinforce magnetic fields.
This causes attraction between the conductors.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is a magnetic circuit?
options: Closed path through which magnetic flux passes
questions.correctOption: Closed path through which magnetic flux passes
questions.explanation: The source defines magnetic circuit as a closed path for magnetic flux. Flux follows this path like current follows an electric circuit.
explanationLines: The source defines magnetic circuit as a closed path for magnetic flux.
Flux follows this path like current follows an electric circuit.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In a series magnetic circuit, total reluctance is ............
questions.explanation: The source says reluctances in series add together. So total reluctance is found by summing each part.
explanationLines: The source says reluctances in series add together.
So total reluctance is found by summing each part.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In a parallel magnetic circuit, total magnetic flux is ............
options: sum of fluxes through each component
questions.correctOption: sum of fluxes through each component
questions.explanation: The source says flux splits in a parallel magnetic circuit. Total flux equals the sum of branch fluxes.
explanationLines: The source says flux splits in a parallel magnetic circuit.
Total flux equals the sum of branch fluxes.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What does the hysteresis loop show?
options: Relation between H and B in a magnetization cycle
questions.correctOption: Relation between H and B in a magnetization cycle
questions.explanation: The source calls it a graphical representation of magnetic behaviour. It shows magnetization and demagnetization of material.
explanationLines: The source calls it a graphical representation of magnetic behaviour.
It shows magnetization and demagnetization of material.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Hysteresis loss appears mainly in the form of ............
questions.explanation: The source says energy loss occurs as heat. It happens during each magnetization and demagnetization cycle.
explanationLines: The source says energy loss occurs as heat.
It happens during each magnetization and demagnetization cycle.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: A smaller hysteresis loop area means ............
questions.explanation: The source directly says smaller loop area gives smaller loss. So narrow loop material wastes less energy as heat.
explanationLines: The source directly says smaller loop area gives smaller loss.
So narrow loop material wastes less energy as heat.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is electromagnetic induction?
options: Production of emf due to relative motion between conductor and magnetic field
questions.correctOption: Production of emf due to relative motion between conductor and magnetic field
questions.explanation: The source defines electromagnetic induction as production of emf or voltage. It happens due to relative motion between conductor and field.
explanationLines: The source defines electromagnetic induction as production of emf or voltage.
It happens due to relative motion between conductor and field.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Who first discovered electromagnetic induction according to the source?
questions.explanation: The source states that Michael Faraday discovered it in 1831 A.D. That is why Faraday's laws are used here.
explanationLines: The source states that Michael Faraday discovered it in 1831 A.D.
That is why Faraday's laws are used here.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: According to Faraday's first law, emf is induced when conductor is placed in ............ field.
questions.explanation: The source says emf is induced in a varying or changing magnetic field. If the circuit is closed, induced current flows.
explanationLines: The source says emf is induced in a varying or changing magnetic field.
If the circuit is closed, induced current flows.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Faraday's second law says induced emf is proportional to ............
questions.explanation: The source says magnitude of induced emf depends on rate of flux linkage. Faster change of flux produces larger emf.
explanationLines: The source says magnitude of induced emf depends on rate of flux linkage.
Faster change of flux produces larger emf.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which method can increase induced emf?
options: Increasing number of turns of coil
questions.correctOption: Increasing number of turns of coil
questions.explanation: The source lists increasing coil turns as one method. More turns give more flux linkage.
explanationLines: The source lists increasing coil turns as one method.
More turns give more flux linkage.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which is also a method to increase induced emf?
questions.explanation: The source says induced emf increases with relative motion speed. Faster motion changes flux more quickly.
explanationLines: The source says induced emf increases with relative motion speed.
Faster motion changes flux more quickly.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What does Lenz law state about induced emf?
options: It opposes the cause that produces it
questions.correctOption: It opposes the cause that produces it
questions.explanation: The source says induced current opposes its producing cause. The negative sign in Faraday's law shows this opposition.
explanationLines: The source says induced current opposes its producing cause.
The negative sign in Faraday's law shows this opposition.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Fleming's right hand rule is used to find ............
questions.explanation: The source says right hand rule is used for induced current direction. It is applicable for generators.
explanationLines: The source says right hand rule is used for induced current direction.
It is applicable for generators.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In Fleming's right hand rule, the middle finger indicates ............
questions.explanation: The source says middle finger shows induced current. Thumb shows motion and fore finger shows magnetic field.
explanationLines: The source says middle finger shows induced current.
Thumb shows motion and fore finger shows magnetic field.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which rule is applicable for generators in this unit?
questions.explanation: The source says Fleming's right hand rule is applicable for generators. It gives the direction of induced current.
explanationLines: The source says Fleming's right hand rule is applicable for generators.
It gives the direction of induced current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is self-induction?
options: Changing current in a coil inducing emf in the same coil
Current induced only in transformer tank
questions.correctOption: Changing current in a coil inducing emf in the same coil
questions.explanation: The source defines self-induction as emf induced in the same coil. This emf opposes the original current change.
explanationLines: The source defines self-induction as emf induced in the same coil.
This emf opposes the original current change.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Self-induced emf opposes ............
questions.explanation: The source says self-induced emf opposes change in current. This is the property of self-inductance.
explanationLines: The source says self-induced emf opposes change in current.
This is the property of self-inductance.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is mutual induction?
options: Changing field of one coil inducing emf in another coil
questions.correctOption: Changing field of one coil inducing emf in another coil
questions.explanation: The source says one coil's changing magnetic field induces emf in a second coil. That phenomenon is called mutual induction.
explanationLines: The source says one coil's changing magnetic field induces emf in a second coil.
That phenomenon is called mutual induction.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: For inductors in series with no linkage, equivalent inductance is ............
questions.explanation: The source gives series equivalent as the sum of inductances. This is for no mutual linkage between inductors.
explanationLines: The source gives series equivalent as the sum of inductances.
This is for no mutual linkage between inductors.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In series aiding coupled inductors, the equivalent inductance includes ............
questions.explanation: The source gives series aiding as L1 + L2 + 2M. Aiding flux increases total inductance.
explanationLines: The source gives series aiding as L1 + L2 + 2M.
Aiding flux increases total inductance.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In series opposing coupled inductors, the equivalent inductance includes ............
questions.explanation: The source gives series opposing as L1 + L2 - 2M. Opposing flux reduces total inductance.
explanationLines: The source gives series opposing as L1 + L2 - 2M.
Opposing flux reduces total inductance.
questions.subject: electrical-machine
